name: MockAPI.io Free
free_limit: Hosted REST API mocking free plan includes 1 project and 2 resources, with generated fake data and RESTful CRUD endpoints; no stated expiration on the Free plan.
watch_out: The Free plan is limited to one project and two resources; custom responses and collaboration are not included. The official pricing page does not clearly state request quotas, card requirements, or commercial-use permission; verify these before production use.
